content: The failure mode is judge capture: the builder doesn't learn the task, it learns the discriminator's fixed biases and blind spots, so scores climb steadily while true quality stagnates or rots — and the rising scores actively mask the degradation. The fix is to split the loop: the builder gets feedback from one judge, but advancement is decided by a held-out judge (or held-out tasks) whose scores it never sees, so it can't be optimized against.
